svg.title: Dependency ordering, not geometric adjacency
svg.desc: Example event DAG: an AGV must lift a blocking tray and repark it before the root tray can be moved to the bay. Columns give one valid topological order.

g.text: An edge u -> v means event u must complete before v may start. It says nothing about distance or travel time. Any order that respects every edge is a valid replay order.
